steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huff, puff, finally got rid of those bastards. How much time have we wasted?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: 22 minutes. Ted's target is also <color=#fb9259>Suspect R</color> in the basement.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We can't let this bastard have it! The entrance to the basement is just up ahead. Hurry...
A Corruptor is attacking a SALVA nurse but gets slammed into the wall by a nightmare.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's going on? Why are there monsters here? Did they defeat Iron already?

steps.speaker: SALVA Nurse
steps.content: No... From the basement, the patients in the quarantine area are being—

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: The Maniacs and that kid can't take any more of this. Let me send them to the basement for refuge.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Basement... Did Ted and <color=#fb9259>that guy</color> trigger Mania in the basement?!

The iron door leading to the quarantine area in the basement is slammed open. Strange sounds can be heard from the deep darkness, which is coming closer and closer, and finally rushes out of the tiny space.
